name: feat
source:
; feature torture test
VDP_CTRL    equ $C00004
COUNT       = 3
RAMBASE     equ $FF0000
        rsreset
plx     rs.w 1
ply     rs.w 1
flags   rs.b 1
        rseven
size    rs.l 0
cnt     set 0
myreg   equr d5
SETREG  macro
        move.\0 #\1,\2
        endm
WAITLP  macro
.wl\@   dbra \1,.wl\@
        endm
DMA     macro
        move.l  #$94009300+(((\1)>>1)&$ff)+((((\1)>>1)&$ff00)<<8),VDP_CTRL
        endm
COND    macro
        ifb \2
        dc.b 1
        mexit
        endc
        dc.b \#
        endm

        org $200
code:
Start:
        SETREG.w $1234,d0
        SETREG.l 5,myreg
        moveq #COUNT,d1
        WAITLP d1
        DMA tiles
        lea plx+RAMBASE,a0
        move.w (ply,a0),d2
        move.w #size,d3
        jsr sub
        bsr sub
        jmp Start
.loop   tst.w d0
        bne.s .loop
        beq .loop
        bra .done
        nop
.done   rts
sub:    move.w #(tiles-code)/2,d0
        lea tiles(pc),a1
        move.l #tiles>>16,d4
        rts
        rept 4
        dc.b REPTN
        endr
        rept 3
        dc.w cnt
cnt     set cnt+2
        endr
        COND 1
        COND 1,2
        if COUNT>2
        dc.b $33
        else
        dc.b $44
        endc
        ifeq COUNT-3
        dc.b $55
        endc
        ifd COUNT
        dc.b $66
        endc
        ifnd NOPE
        dc.b $77
        endc
        iif COUNT=3 dc.b $88
        dc.b "Hello",0,'it''s'
        even
        cnop 0,8
tiles:  dc.l $11111111,$22222222
        dcb.w 3,$abcd
        ds.b 5
        align 2
        dc.w *-tiles
        dc.l tiles+4,tiles-code
        incbin "bin.dat"
        incbin "bin.dat",1,2
        even
tblend:
        org $100
hdr:    dc.b "SEGA MEGA DRIVE "
        dc.l Start
        org 0
        dc.l $00FFE000,Start
